verdict.rationale: Base44's core interaction model is natural language. Users describe what they want and the AI builds or updates code, styles and components (docs-31, docs-33, docs-14, docs-34, probe-1). Superagents and in-app AI agents turn chats into actions such as updating records, triggering workflows and controlling the browser (docs-6, docs-43, docs-48). Community hands-on reports corroborate building and deploying apps from a couple of prompts (comm-5, comm-6), though comm-8 notes users can hit walls getting the AI to do things. Missing for 10: independent evidence on how reliably natural-language commands cover complex edits without hitting those walls.
